اختلطوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَطُوا (iḵtalaṭū) /ix.ta.la.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَلَطَ (iḵtalaṭa)
# اِخْتَلِطُوا (iḵtaliṭū) /ix.ta.li.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَطَ (iḵtalaṭa)
